keyword.zh: 柴油120是不是两台发动机

title.en: Air compressor does not replace what Diesel 120 Prints Two Engine Units lists
title.zh: 「空氣壓縮機」不能替换柴油120怎样印出两台发动机列出的数字

description.en: Diesel 120 Prints Two Engine Units. 290 kW stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Air compressor.
description.zh: 柴油120怎样印出两台发动机。290 kW仍在目录格子里。插图来自「空氣壓縮機」。

h1.en: Air compressor does not replace what Diesel 120 Prints Two Engine Units lists
h1.zh: 「空氣壓縮機」不能替换柴油120怎样印出两台发动机列出的数字

directAnswer.en: The Diesel 120 concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists engine power as 290 kW (two units 145 kW). The hydraulic-pump entry lists Kawasaki 112 (two units). The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Air_compressor.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的柴油120混凝土泵把发动机功率写成 290 kW（两台各 145 kW）。理论输送量是单独的 100 m³/h，不是每台发动机 100。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Air_compressor。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Air_compressor: AirCompressorHusky. The Diesel 120 concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists engine power as 290 kW (two units 145 kW). The page does not list a procedure for running one unit alone, so this note does not invent one. The output entry already says 100 m³/h. Unlike LZ-80, Diesel 120 does not list high and low ceilings.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Air_compressor页上的AirCompressorHusky。河北品锦机械在邢台的柴油120混凝土泵把发动机功率写成 290 kW（两台各 145 kW）。河北品锦机械没有在这一页标出 4105、4108 或 6105。如果这个问题重要，请用 /zh/contact/，不要猜一个一半的产量。

body.en: The hydraulic-pump entry lists Kawasaki 112 (two units). It refers to the power entry and, separately, to the hydraulic-pump entry. It does not say 100 m³/h times two. It also does not say that one 145 kW unit is a listed operating mode.
body.zh: 理论输送量是单独的 100 m³/h，不是每台发动机 100。距离也是一组：水平 150 m，垂直 500 m。

body.en: Theoretical output is a single 100 m³/h, not 100 per engine. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list the engine code 4105, 4108 or 6105 on this page. Adding another 100 would invent a figure. If that question matters, use /en/contact/ rather than a guessed half output.
body.zh: 出口压力 40 MPa，距离 150 m / 500 m。和 LZ-80 不同，柴油120没有标出高低两档上限。

body.en: Outlet pressure is 40 MPa and distance is 150 m / 500 m. Aggregate is 6 cm and below. The distance pair is likewise one pair, 150 m horizontal and 500 m vertical. Also on this row: cm and below. Weight is 8000 kg. The output ce.
body.zh: 页面没有标出只开一台的步骤，因此本文也不编造。它也没有说一台 145 kW 是列出的运行模式。这一行还有这些已印出的片段：cm and below. Weight is 8000 kg. The output ce。

question.en: How many kilowatts are shown in total?

answer.en: 290 kW, written as two units of 145 kW. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Air_compressor.
answer.zh: 290 kW，写成两台各 145 kW。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Air_compressor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is output 200 m³/h if there are two engines?
question.zh: 两台发动机是否意味着产量 200 m³/h？

answer.en: No. The shown theoretical output is 100 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Air_compressor.
answer.zh: 不是。写出的理论输送量是 100 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Air_compressor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: What hydraulic pump text is shown?

answer.en: Kawasaki 112 (two units). It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Air_compressor.
answer.zh: 川崎112（两台）。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Air_compressor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Does the page list a one-engine setting?
question.zh: 页面列出单发动机设定吗？

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list that mode. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Air_compressor.
answer.zh: 没有。河北品锦机械没有标出这种模式。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Air_compressor画面里印出的数字。
